name: documentation-update
description: Update README, ARCHITECTURE, and inline docs before touching implementation.
template:
RACT DOCUMENTATION-UPDATE SKILL

Before changing implementation, update the project's documentation so it describes the intended state accurately. Documentation is a first-class artifact in RACT.

Required:
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: update module descriptions if architecture changed.
- Inline docstrings for new or changed public functions, each including an LR:: note for non-obvious behavior.

Style rules:
- Do not change implementation until docs match intent.

Intent: $intent
